title: The Bells Rung
subtitle: A command reward, with placeholders
description: A command reward runs through the server's own dispatcher with the
player as the source, at `permissionLevel` 2 by default -- a command
block's level. The command is written without its leading slash.
The brace-words are the legacy format's own placeholders, kept
whole: `{p}` is the player's scoreboard name, `{quest}` the quest's
id, `{chapter}` the chapter's, and `{x}` `{y}` `{z}` the block they
stand on. An unknown brace-word is left as written rather than
blanked, so a typo is visible in the log.

rewards.command: say {p} has rung the bell of {chapter}
